title: Causative Chains in Academic & Institutional Contexts
goal: I can distinguish intransitive causatives where the causee takes the accusative (-t) from transitive causatives where the causee takes -val/-vel
I can use cognitive and behavioral causatives such as elgondolkodtat, megdolgoztat, and szerepeltet
I can analyze institutional and intellectual influence in formal Hungarian prose
